name: SAEngine steel design
description: Steel member and connection design, the steel section library, the steel drawing sheets and the steel results panel of SAEngine.
notes: The steel tables of a design code (BNBC 2020: python/src/saengine/codes/packs/bnbc2020/data/steel.json) belong to the code pack and are published by saengine-design-codes, not here.
The shared design pipeline that calls steel (design/check.py, design/proposal.py, design/overwrites.py, report/build.py, library/objects.py, drawings/sheets/model.py) stays in the core.
